status: Development feasibility protocol, fixed before the expanded comparison
selection: Record zero of each author training split; no validation or test records
queries: All three initial coordinate-median half-spaces, without selecting the most difficult or favorable axis
sensor: Fixed orthographic 64x64 z-buffer, exact depth, one front-most particle per bin; drop points outside the camera rectangle
primary_diagnostic: Pooled balanced binary source accuracy per trajectory, query, stride and method
limitations: Three simulation trajectories, one per material, not a statistical benchmark. Frame observations are correlated. No neural model and no real RGB inference. Results do not establish novelty.
